info.title: Orbis Tier 4 Arbitrage Suite
info.description: Eight arbitrage intelligence APIs: DEX vs CEX Arbitrage, Triangular Arbitrage, Stablecoin Arbitrage, Cross-Chain Arbitrage, NFT Arbitrage, Gas-Adjusted Arbitrage, Flash Loan Opportunity, and Market Inefficiency Scanner. All endpoints require an X-API-Key header. Free tier: 100 req/day. Pay-per-call pricing from $0.003 to $0.020/call. All responses include financial_disclaimer — for informational purposes only, not financial advice.
